trip_summary: A balanced six-day Lisbon itinerary for two travellers, combining historic neighbourhoods, Belém, Sintra, contemporary Lisbon, and one planned football-match evening. The itinerary assumes five nights in a mid-range or well-reviewed budget accommodation and excludes international flights because no departure city was provided.

days.title: Arrival and Baixa introduction
days.weather_note: November is often mild but changeable, with a reasonable chance of rain; keep a light waterproof layer available.

activities.name: Arrival, check-in and unpacking
activities.description: Arrive in Lisbon, transfer to accommodation and settle in. Allow extra time if arriving during afternoon traffic.

activities.name: Praça do Comércio and Ribeira das Naus
activities.description: Take an easy first walk along the waterfront and through Lisbon’s monumental central square.

activities.name: Baixa and Rossio orientation walk
activities.description: Explore Rua Augusta, Rossio Square and nearby streets at a relaxed pace.

activities.name: Portuguese dinner
activities.description: Have an early dinner in Baixa or Mouraria; try petiscos, grilled fish or a traditional rice dish.

days.title: Belém’s monuments and riverside
days.weather_note: The exposed waterfront can feel cooler and windier than central Lisbon.

activities.name: Jerónimos Monastery
activities.description: Visit the church and, if open and tickets are available, the cloisters. Consider arriving early to reduce queueing.

activities.name: Monument to the Discoveries
activities.description: See the monument and riverside promenade; the viewing platform is optional and subject to opening conditions.

activities.name: Belém Tower exterior and waterfront
activities.description: Walk toward the tower and enjoy views across the Tagus. Access inside may be restricted depending on conservation work or conditions.

activities.name: Lunch and pastel de nata stop
activities.description: Lunch in Belém, with time for the neighbourhood’s famous custard tart tradition.

activities.name: MAAT or riverside alternative
activities.description: Visit MAAT if its current exhibition programme appeals to you; otherwise continue along the riverside toward Alcântara.

activities.name: Dinner near Cais do Sodré
activities.description: Choose a casual restaurant or food hall and return to the accommodation by metro, tram or taxi.

days.title: Sintra day trip
days.weather_note: Sintra is usually cooler and wetter than Lisbon; wear comfortable shoes and bring rain protection.

activities.name: Travel to Sintra
activities.description: Take the suburban train from Rossio to Sintra. Leave early to make the most of the day and reduce the risk of long queues.
activities.travel_time_to_next: 15-25 minutes by local bus or taxi

activities.name: Pena Palace and park
activities.description: Visit Pena Palace if timed tickets are available. If tickets are unavailable, explore the park or substitute Quinta da Regaleira.

activities.name: Sintra village lunch
activities.description: Have lunch in the historic centre and try a local queijada or travesseiro pastry.

activities.name: Quinta da Regaleira
activities.description: Explore the gardens, wells and symbolic architecture. The visit involves uneven paths and stairs.

activities.name: Return to Lisbon
activities.description: Return by train and allow a short rest at the accommodation.

activities.name: Relaxed dinner
activities.description: Keep the evening simple after the full day, with dinner near the accommodation.

days.title: Alfama, viewpoints and central Lisbon
days.weather_note: Cobblestones can become slippery in rain; supportive footwear is recommended.

activities.name: Alfama walking route
activities.description: Explore Sé Cathedral, narrow lanes and small squares at a relaxed pace. Avoid rushing the steepest sections.

activities.name: Miradouro de Santa Luzia and Portas do Sol
activities.description: Stop at two classic viewpoints for city and river views.

activities.name: Lunch in Graça
activities.description: Walk or take a short ride uphill for lunch around Graça.

activities.name: São Jorge Castle
activities.description: Explore the castle grounds and viewpoints if tickets are available; allow for uphill walking.

activities.name: Chiado and Carmo
activities.description: Browse Chiado and visit the Carmo Convent ruins if desired, then pause for coffee.

activities.name: Fado evening or Portuguese dinner
activities.description: Choose a small fado venue only after checking the current programme and cover charge, or have dinner in Bairro Alto.

days.title: Contemporary Lisbon and football match
days.weather_note: Keep the match plan flexible because the exact fixture, kickoff time and ticket availability may not yet be confirmed.

activities.name: Parque das Nações and Oriente
activities.description: Explore the modern riverside district, Gare do Oriente and public waterfront spaces.

activities.name: Optional Oceanário de Lisboa
activities.description: Visit the aquarium if it is a priority; otherwise extend the riverside walk to keep costs lower.

activities.name: Lunch and rest
activities.description: Have lunch near Oriente, then return to the accommodation or rest before the evening match.

activities.name: Travel to stadium and pre-match meal
activities.description: Travel to Estádio da Luz or Estádio José Alvalade, depending on the confirmed Lisbon fixture. Arrive early for security and seating.
activities.location: Estádio da Luz or Estádio José Alvalade

activities.name: Football match
activities.description: Attend one Lisbon football match. The Saturday fixture is a planning placeholder: the 2026-27 schedule, opponent, kickoff time and ticket prices should be verified when released. Purchase through the club or an authorised seller.
activities.location: Estádio da Luz or Estádio José Alvalade

activities.name: Post-match snack and return
activities.description: Have a light late meal near the accommodation or stadium area and return using official transport or a licensed taxi/rideshare.

days.title: Final stroll and departure
days.weather_note: Allow a generous airport buffer, particularly if departing on a Sunday afternoon or evening.

activities.name: Breakfast and check-out
activities.description: Settle the accommodation bill, store luggage if possible and keep valuables with you.

activities.name: Final stroll through Mouraria or Praça do Comércio
activities.description: Use the final morning for photographs, souvenirs and any sights missed earlier.

activities.name: Lunch
activities.description: Have an early lunch before collecting luggage and travelling to the airport.

activities.name: Airport transfer and departure buffer
activities.description: Travel to Humberto Delgado Airport. Adjust this time to match the actual flight and allow extra time for baggage and security.

recommendations: Stay in Baixa, Chiado, Avenida da Liberdade, or near Alameda for convenient access to sights and public transport.
Reserve Sintra palace tickets and any desired museum entries in advance once the 2026 booking calendars are available.
For the football match, check Benfica and Sporting CP home fixtures when the 2026-27 schedule is published, then buy only through official club channels or authorised sellers.
Use a rechargeable public-transport card or contactless payment where accepted; validate the current fare rules before travelling.
Book restaurants and any fado venue ahead for Friday or Saturday evening, especially for small venues.
warnings: A specific Lisbon football fixture, kickoff time and ticket price for 14 November 2026 cannot be confirmed from the information provided. The match activity should be moved to the actual home-match date if necessary.

The itinerary assumes a suitable home match is available in Lisbon during the trip. If no match is scheduled or tickets cannot be obtained, use an official stadium tour or another authorised football experience as a fallback, subject to availability.
Opening days, admission prices, transport fares and access restrictions for attractions may change before November 2026; verify them close to travel.
The €1,500 budget excludes international flights and assumes economical-to-mid-range accommodation booked at a reasonable rate.
The Sintra day is weather-sensitive. In heavy rain, reduce the number of outdoor sites and prioritise one palace plus the village.
packing_tips: Comfortable shoes with good grip for steep streets, cobblestones and Sintra paths.
Light waterproof jacket, compact umbrella and a warm layer for November evenings.
Small day bag for museum visits and the football match; check the stadium’s current bag-size rules before attending.
Portable phone battery and offline maps for neighbourhood walks.
Travel documents, payment card and a small amount of cash for incidental purchases.
assumptions: The trip is for two travellers sharing one room for five nights.
Estimated costs are for both travellers combined and are stated in EUR.
The accommodation estimate assumes approximately €110 per night; actual rates may vary substantially by booking date and room type.
Daily costs are approximate and may not exactly equal the category budget breakdown because some expenses are paid in advance or vary by choice.
No departure airport, arrival time or departure time was provided, so arrival and departure activities use flexible placeholder times.
The football match budget assumes approximately €60 per person for standard tickets, but actual prices depend on the club, opponent, competition and seating area.
